programme.desc: The historian concludes his tour of the country beginning with a visit to Venice, where he meets actor Ciaran Hinds to discuss why the Bard chose the city as the setting for The Merchant of Venice. Francesco is then joined by Mark Rylance in Rome as they explore how the playwright used the Italian capital for the plots of Julius Caesar and Antony and Cleopatra to avoid Elizabethan censors. Finally, on the island of Stromboli, off the northern coast of Sicily, Francesco uncovers the location for Shakespeare's late masterpiece - The Tempest

programme.title: Shakespeare: Rise of a Genius
programme.desc: Docudrama telling the story of how a glover's son from rural Stratford became arguably the greatest writer that ever lived, using a series of cinematic vignettes combined with contributions from stars and experts including Judi Dench, Brian Cox, Adrian Lester and Helen Mirren. The story begins in 1587, when William Shakespeare leaves his small rural home town to pursue his dream of becoming a playwright in London. He begins as a stagehand and occasional actor. But then he writes a gory revenge play, Titus Andronicus, which does well, followed by a teenage romance that becomes a breakout success - Romeo and Juliet

programme.title: Britain's Most Expensive Houses
programme.desc: The company's UK director Jason is determined to bag a very personal listing, Otterburn Castle in Northumberland, which was once owned by his great-great-great-great-grandfather - and pulling out all the stops, he even brings along his mum to convince the current owner that he is the broker for the job. Constance tries to find a London penthouse with a great view for Italian first-time buyers Alessandro and Ilenia, while John takes on a stunning property in the Surrey hills which was featured in Beauty and the Beast and Star Wars

programme.title: Location, Location, Location
programme.desc: Kirstie Allsopp visits Devon to meet single mother Michelle, who has moved back to Exmouth and wants a place she and her son Dan can call home. After many failed offers, Michelle feels stuck in her small rented apartment that was only ever meant to be temporary. It's the lowest stock levels Kirstie's ever seen, meaning good luck and property prowess are required in equal measure if she's to find that needle in a haystack for Michelle

programme.title: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces
programme.desc: George has the idea of turning a rusty scissor lift into a cabin in the sky and starts his Denmark trip with a visit to a modern take on the old Viking longhouse. After a bus from a previous series burned in a fire, its owner replaces it with an ambitious new build made of four shipping containers. Plus, a beautician and her daughter create a four-wheeled beauty parlour

programme.title: A Place in the Sun
programme.desc: Keen ballroom dancer Neil has holidayed on the Greek island of Kefalonia 15 times and loves it so much he now wants his own holiday home there. Ben Hillman shows Neil and his mother Corinne five properties to consider within his budget of £350,000

programme.title: Worst House on the Street
programme.desc: Best friends Brad and Billy have bought their first home together to get on the property ladder, but all they could afford is a very dated and run-down house in Coventry. Scarlette and Stuart Douglas help them to make the most of their new home

programme.title: Channel 4 News
programme.desc: Including sport and weather

programme.title: Kevin McCloud's Listed Britain
programme.desc: Kevin travels the country to uncover the stories behind the buildings Britain has chosen to protect at the very highest level. In the first episode, he raises Tower Bridge and descends into its Victorian engine rooms, and enters a church beneath which 1500 years of London's history lie buried. In the oldest continuously working theatre in the English-speaking world, Kevin tries out a piece of stage machinery that's still operating after more than two centuries

programme.title: Kevin McCloud's Classic Car Road Trips
programme.desc: Kevin drives classic cars in the countries where they were made, to discover more about both the country and the car. In this first episode, Kevin explores the French Riviera in a classic 1960s Citroen DS convertible. Kevin's journey takes him from Cannes via a wandering route to Monaco. First stop is an internationally renowned design school near Nice. What will the designers of tomorrow think of a car built 40 years before they were born?

programme.title: Apocalypse
programme.desc: The two camps meet for a friendly midnight game of hide and seek in the abandoned hospital. But while the West have a full pantry, the East are still struggling for food. On a visit to the East, chef Dean creates a tasty feast featuring cat food and pig trotters. Later Dean makes a huge discovery that leaves him with a big decision to make

programme.title: Gogglebox
programme.desc: The armchair critics share their opinions on what they have been watching during the week, featuring Coronation Street, The Celebrity Traitors, Made in Chelsea, Strictly Come Dancing, Tempting Fortune, Bridge of Lies and Clodagh: Cooking at Home

programme.title: 999: On the Front Line
programme.desc: Paramedics treat a man who's having a heart attack but thinks he's just pulled a muscle. He has no history of cardiac issues, but an examination confirms that his heart is blocked. A day out hiking ends badly for a man when he falls and injures his ankle, and the paramedics' tea and toast making skills are needed for a diabetic patient.

programme.title: Ernest Cole: Lost and Found (2024)
programme.desc: Documentary following Ernest Cole's journey as the first black freelance photographer in apartheid-era South Africa, and how he was forced to flee the country for New York in the 1960s. However, most of his work stayed unpublished until 2017, when 60,000 negatives were found in a Swedish bank safe

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: The chef heads to family owned Italian restaurant Giuseppi's in Macomb Township, Michigan. Father and son Joe and Sam Borgia's constant fighting is driving customers away, and Gordon discovers one of the restaurateurs is concealing a serious health problem. Nevertheless, he sets about rescuing them from disaster and turning around the failing business

programme.title: Fellow Travelers
programme.desc: Roy Cohn's obsession with David Schine leads to the televised Army-McCarthy hearings, which soon turns into a national scandal. McCarthy's allies repeatedly attack Senator Smith, threatening to expose family secrets and prompting Hawk to do everything he can to protect him, and his own secret life. Tim is exposed to Hawk's true nature, which inspires him to make a life-changing decision about his future

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: A trilogy of spine-chilling tales, featuring giant billboard characters coming to life, Groundskeeper Willie's nightmarish revenge and a mysterious 'third dimension' discovered by Homer. Featuring the guest voice of Paul Anka

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Sideshow Bob gets a job as a Santa at a mall, while someone is stealing all the Christmas packages off people's front porches in Springfield

programme.title: Break Clause
programme.desc: Things are heating up between Ben and Lil, who bunk off work to enjoy a day out in London - but when Ben finds out some unpalatable truths about Lil's move to the capital, things turn nasty

programme.title: Break Clause
programme.desc: It's the weekend before Ben and Lil leave the flat for good. She is going to Berlin and he is staying on Frances' sofa. But when Lil's parents let her down, it's Ben who steps up, making her question everything. Can they work things out before it's too late?

programme.title: X. (2022)
programme.desc: Film producer Wayne bankrolls X-rated fantasy The Farmer's Daughters featuring his fame-hungry girlfriend Maxine, burlesque dancer Bobby-Lynne and porn star Jackson Hole. The film-makers venture into the Texan countryside to shoot on location at a farm belonging to elderly couple Howard and Pearl. However, before long the cast are fighting for their lives. Seventies-set horror, starring Mia Goth, Brittany Snow and Jenna Ortega

programme.title: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces

programme.desc: The architect heads off to Italy, where it seems the residents have also been bitten by the 'small buildings are beautiful' bug. Back in Britain, George meets a man turning a wrecked private jet into a crash pad and a Gypsy tattoo artist with big plans for an old railway carriage. George also challenges his pal, craftsman Will Hardie, to create a woodland retreat for less than the price of a family holiday

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Sam decides to donate one of his baseball jerseys to a charity auction, but it fails to attract any interest until Diane takes pity on him and secretly bids for it. Ted Danson stars

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off
programme.desc: The six remaining bakers battle it out for a place in the quarter-finals. This time, it is dessert week, and Mel Giedroyc and Sue Perkins assemble the contestants for three more challenges. To begin with, the amateurs face a sweetly filled signature bake, before moving on to prepare a tricky French dessert that proves to be one of the series' toughest technical challenges to date. Finally, for the showstopper, Paul Hollywood and Mary Berry ask the bakers to produce multi-bake, mini masterpieces. Plus, Sue visits Paris for a lesson on the history of praline

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off
programme.desc: The quarter-finals arrive, and only five contestants remain in the tent, and as the stakes get ever higher for the amateur bakers, Mel Giedroyc and Sue Perkins introduce yet another new Bake Off challenge - Tudor week. All three tasks this week revolve around baking practices from the time of Henry VIII, beginning with a signature bake in the form of savoury-stuffed pies. In the technical heat, the contenders are asked to prepare unusual knotted Tudor biscuits, while the showstopper takes the form of a marzipan spectacle fit to grace a banquet tables at court. Plus, Sue Perkins visits Hampton Court to discover how a sweet delicacy nearly tempted the Virgin Queen Elizabeth I to marry

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off
programme.desc: Only four bakers remain as the semi-final arrives. This week, the contestants must demonstrate their mastery of patisserie in three more challenges. However, the stakes have never been higher, and a disaster in any one of the rounds might mean the difference between claiming a place in the final, or bowing out early. In the Signature, the bakers must achieve perfect lamination on French pastries, and in the Technical, Paul Hollywood puts the amateurs through their paces with a yeast-based cake with a fruity top and delicate chocolate work. For the showstopper finale, the competitors face a multiple mini-cake bake, with Paul and fellow judge Mary Berry expecting a high-end finish that demonstrates the bakers' ability to manage their time

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off
programme.desc: Mel Giedroyc and Sue Perkins present this year's grand final, as the three remaining bakers compete to impress judges Mary Berry and Paul Hollywood and take home the trophy for 2016 . For the final three challenges, they must prepare perfect meringues and are set a seemingly simple technical task with a twist - the recipe only includes one instruction. Finally, they must prove their worth in the most complex showstopper ever featured on the show

programme.title: The Rosenbergs: Atomic Spies
programme.desc: How, in 1950 with America in the throes of the Red Scare, seemingly ordinary couple Julius and Ethel Rosenberg found themselves the target of anti-Communist hysteria. Arrested by the FBI and accused of passing secret information to the USSR, they maintained their innocence while the media and public opinion seemed to condemned them. Their trial did nothing to change this and ended in a death sentence. Using archival footage, this documentary revisits the intriguing case

programme.desc: The spectre of racial unrest looms over Sun Hill following a number of assaults on the Muslim community, allegedly committed by white youths. As the three officers killed in the explosion are laid to rest, Neil arouses his wife's suspicions by attending Andrea's funeral, while Laura is unconvinced by Gabriel's whiter-than-white demeanour

programme.title: The Bill

programme.title: Great Continental Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Armed with his trusty 1913 Bradshaw's Continental Railway Guide, Michael Portillo travels east through the Balkans along the most exotic section of the route taken by the Orient Express. His journey begins in Sofia, capital of Bulgaria, and includes stops in the ancient city of Plovdiv, the region of Rumelia, and former capital of the Ottoman Empire Edirne. Arriving in Istanbul, Michael takes a trip on the Bosphorus - a much-coveted stretch of water - finds out about Turkish delight and travels along the Marmaray metro line, which connects European and Asian Istanbul via a tunnel beneath the Bosphorus

programme.title: Teleshopping
programme.desc: A chance to buy goods from the comfort of home

programme.title: Great Continental Railway Journeys
programme.desc: In Vienna, Michael Portillo encounters a pre-Cold War spy and learns about the concert that caused a riot in 1913. He then travels the Habsburg imperial line across the Semmering Pass, a line blasted through the Alps. In Graz, the former politician ventures underground at the Lurgrotte Caves to find out about a famous rescue operation of the past, then in Slovenia discovers how an earthquake in Ljubljana prompted its citizens to assert their national identity in architecture and art. Arriving in the Italian port of Trieste, Michael savours the imported coffee that fuelled a cafe culture

programme.title: Great Continental Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo experiences first-hand Italy's 'need for speed' in a state-of-the-art Maserati sports car, and discovers how the leaning tower of Pisa was rescued from near collapse. In Carrara, he finds out how the marble used by Michelangelo is still being quarried and is invited to chip away at a contemporary sculpture. Moving on to Bologna, the former politician embarks on a doomed search for spaghetti bolognese before being taught how to prepare a tagliatelle al ragu. Finally, he lets the wind rush through his hair on a high-speed boat trip across Lake Garda

programme.title: Great Canal Journeys
programme.desc: Timothy West and Prunella Scales return to the Oxford Canal, the waterway where they first fell in love with boating more than 40 years ago. Aboard their own boat, they travel north from Banbury, heading for the old canal port of Braunston, joined by their daughter Juliet and sons Sam and Joe. As they navigate their way through the beautiful Cherwell Valley, the couple look back at some their favourite voyages on the inland waterways of Britain and Ireland. As well as remembering great moments of joy and wonder, the voyage is tinged with sadness given the recent deterioration in Pru's dementia

programme.title: Great Canal Journeys
programme.desc: Timothy West and Prunella Scales embark on a journey into their pasts via the Leeds and Liverpool Canal, which celebrated its 200th anniversary in 2016. Along the way, they visit the country's last surviving steam-powered textile mill, meander through the 'curlies', and meet acclaimed poet Simon Armitage. They also take a trip by steam train to the home of the Bronte sisters in Haworth, and are confronted by the Salts Mill after tackling the steepest lock staircase in Britain

programme.title: Michael Palin: Travels of a Lifetime
programme.desc: Michael Palin looks back on the making of Pole to Pole, in which he travelled along a single line of longitude across the USSR, Africa and finally into Antarctica. Along the way, he paid a visit to Chernobyl and gained an insight into the last days of the Soviet Union. His travels across Africa led to an encounter with some fellow globetrotters from his home town of Sheffield - but he was forced to make a detour when his planned route passed through a war zone

programme.title: Train Rescue Down Under
programme.desc: A locomotive needs a quick double bogie change to get back to the sugarcane harvest. Meanwhile, the heat is on for a tricky air conditioner replacement

programme.title: Flipping Bangers
programme.desc: British car enthusiasts Will Trickett and Gus Gregory have just one week to fix neglected cars and double their selling price. Here, the duo head to London to buy a '73 Mk 4 Spitfire. It seems solid, but how it fares on the road remains to be seen

programme.title: Flipping Bangers
programme.desc: Will Trickett and Gus Gregory head to the West Country to buy a Golf GTI. Gus hates it on sight, but Will is smitten. They soon discover why the car is laid up - it has no engine

programme.title: Canal Boat Diaries
programme.desc: Robbie Cumming navigates the Oxford Canal, bumps into a hire boat and a hedge, and tackles large river locks on the scenic upper Thames

programme.title: Canal Boat Diaries
programme.desc: Robbie's narrowboat gets a makeover before he explores the River Thames, he moors in Abingdon and tackles an emergency DIY repair to fix a leak

programme.title: Saving Lives at Sea
programme.desc: In Porthcawl, a fisherman is dragged lifeless out of the sea by bystanders and the lifeboat crew race to the beach to join the desperate attempts to resuscitate him. A yacht loses control in Lytham St Annes and is in danger of breaking up on nearby Blackpool beach. The Poole crew are called out at 2am to look for a man who has fallen into the harbour

programme.title: Blue Planet II
programme.desc: Footage of wildlife inhabiting underwater kelp forests, including thousands of giant cuttlefish spawning along a restricted area of rocky reef off the south coast of Australia. Males outnumber females 11 to one, which leads to fierce competition. Larger males use brute force to drive off competition, while their smaller rivals use deception by mimicking the appearance of females. The programme also features tiger sharks hunting for green turtles in fields of seagrass and spider crabs trying to avoid predators while they shed their shells

programme.title: Blue Planet II
programme.desc: Footage of animals that live on the coast, including sea lions working in packs to hunt tuna in the shallows and moray eels that venture out of the water to seek out food on dry rocks. Puffins must brave predators to bring a mouthful of food back to their young and king penguins go without food for a month while they moult. Plus, footage of the bizarre Leaping Blenny, a fish that hates the water

programme.desc: The team buy a confusing 1984 French Matra Murena and send it to Citroen specialists. Next, they take on a Bond classic - no, not that one - a 1977 Arctic Wetbike!

programme.title: Bangers & Cash: Restoring Classics
programme.desc: The team snap up one of the most popular cars in the Eastern Bloc: a 1969 Sachsenring Trabant. Plus, they attempt to make a profit with a 1990 Renault 5 Monaco

programme.title: Classic Car Kings
programme.desc: Irv restores a 1970s Lamborghini Espada for a client in the Middle East. Hidden structural damage and spiralling engine issues threaten the entire project

programme.title: Bangers & Cash: Restoring Classics

programme.desc: Armed with his trusty 1913 Bradshaw's Continental Railway Guide, Michael Portillo travels east through the Balkans along the most exotic section of the route taken by the Orient Express. Arriving in Istanbul, Michael takes a trip on the Bosphorus - a much-coveted stretch of water - finds out about Turkish delight and travels along the Marmaray metro line, which connects European and Asian Istanbul via a tunnel beneath the Bosphorus

programme.title: Great Continental Railway Journeys
programme.desc: In Vienna, Michael Portillo encounters a pre-Cold War spy and learns about the concert that caused a riot in 1913. He then travels the Habsburg imperial line across the Semmering Pass, a line blasted through the Alps. In Graz, the former politician ventures underground at the Lurgrotte Caves to find out about a famous rescue operation of the past, then in Slovenia discovers how an earthquake in Ljubljana prompted its citizens to assert their national identity in architecture and art. Aboard their own boat, they travel north from Banbury, heading for the old canal port of Braunston, joined by their daughter Juliet and sons Sam and Joe. As they navigate their way through the beautiful Cherwell Valley, the couple look back at some their favourite voyages on the inland waterways of Britain and Ireland. As well as remembering great moments of joy and wonder, the voyage is tinged with sadness given the recent deterioration in Pru's dementia

programme.title: Great Canal Journeys

Along the way, they visit the country's last surviving steam-powered textile mill, meander through the 'curlies', and meet acclaimed poet Simon Armitage. They also take a trip by steam train to the home of the Bronte sisters in Haworth, and are confronted by the Salts Mill after tackling the steepest lock staircase in Britain

programme.title: Michael Palin: Travels of a Lifetime

Along the way, he paid a visit to Chernobyl and gained an insight into the last days of the Soviet Union. His travels across Africa led to an encounter with some fellow globetrotters from his home town of Sheffield - but he was forced to make a detour when his planned route passed through a war zone

programme.title: Ana Kriegel: A Young Life Lost

Here, senior journalists, barristers and family friends tell Ana's story, looking at the circumstances around her murder, the extensive Garda investigation and the trial that followed. Featuring a series of new photographs released by Ana's family, the documentary also examines the sentencing in this unprecedented case and explores the lasting impact of Ana's death
